Arthur Balfour
Arthur James Balfour, 1st Earl of Balfour, (usually , but traditionally /bəɫˈfʉr/ in Scottish English; 25 July 184819 March 1930) was a British Conservative politician who was the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from July 1902 to December 1905, and later Foreign Secretary.
